name: surefirestudios/tcgiant-sync
description: Development tooling for the TCGiant Sync WordPress plugin. Not shipped with the plugin.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run php -l over every plugin source file.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run lint then analyse — use this before tagging a release.
scripts-descriptions.build: Build a distributable plugin zip into zips/.
scripts-descriptions.check-views: Verify admin view markup is balanced and grid layouts have their columns.
scripts-descriptions.check-formats: Run every printf-style format string through sprintf to catch ones that would throw at runtime.
scripts-descriptions.check-tabs: Verify the in-page tab bar lists the same pages as the admin menu, in the same order.
scripts-descriptions.check-limit-gates: Verify the free product limit holds back new listings without stopping a sync outright.
